result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its five entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks it. `git-history.zip` is written as well when `git-history.txt` exists. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests and didn't try a renamed config.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the zip step of `saveData`. It now builds the entry names with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same call that names the loose `aspect_*.txt` files. The order is still main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

With the default config the entries stay `aspect_main.txt` through `aspect_other.txt`, as before. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.
